_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 17: April 2025, completing everything to 2025-06-30. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for Canada to rise up and give it their last call, saying a dividing line will come for Canada and a great shaking to awaken is coming there even more.
mentions.quote: this is a dividing line that will come for Canada
mentions.falsify_match: A national crisis or religious awakening in Canada.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord warned that over the course of the summer there will be an even greater acceleration of the sin and evil behind that platform, with an uncovering from July through October.
mentions.quote: you will see an uncovering even more from July, August, September, October
mentions.falsify_match: Major disclosures about the previous administration across those four months.

mentions.claim_text: He clarifies that the pope he saw standing next to the Antichrist was not in a wheelchair, so it was obviously not this pope, and says he had hoped it was because he is looking for his redemption.
mentions.quote: he was standing next to Antichrist. He wasn't sitting in a wheelchair
mentions.falsify_match: A future pope, able-bodied, appearing alongside a figure identified as the Antichrist.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Notable as a correction: he rules out the reading he wanted.

mentions.claim_text: A word of knowledge to a young woman watching who had an abortion and believes Jesus will not forgive her, telling her he sees her heart.
mentions.quote: I don't know who that is, but I see your heart, young lady
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable in practice: a circumstance common enough that any large audience supplies a match.

mentions.claim_text: He retells the Starbucks detail: in the 6 July 2014 visitation Jesus took him out of his body into the tribulation and there was a Starbucks in the town that did not exist yet.
mentions.quote: there was no Starbucks. This was back in uh 2014, July the 6th
mentions.falsify_match: The building of that Starbucks, which he says has since happened.

mentions.claim_text: He cites a child who found something by accident worth four million dollars, and says there are hidden treasures in the fountains of the deep.
mentions.quote: there's hidden treasures in in the fountains of the deep
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a promise of windfalls with no criterion.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that homeland security, the FBI, local law enforcement and sheriff's departments uncover plots through leaks and through ordinary citizens paying attention and speaking up.
mentions.quote: will uncover it through leaks, through even, Father, through our citizens
mentions.falsify_match: Plots disrupted by tip-offs, which is the ordinary base rate for counterterrorism.

mentions.claim_text: Naming Justin Trudeau and the new leader, he prays that Canadians say they want godly people and godly character and will not be satisfied until they get it, and that Canada turns around.
mentions.quote: Canada will turn around in the name of Jesus
mentions.falsify_match: A conservative or religious turn in Canadian politics.

mentions.claim_text: He says he will not be controlled by religion, by Christianity as a whole or by TV Christianity, that he follows the voice of God and is radical about it, and that this is why he does not fit.
mentions.quote: I will follow the voice of God and I'm radical about it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a statement of posture.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that viewers hear his voice and not a stranger's, know exactly where to put their money, and that this is the day of the open door and 2025 a time to get on track.
mentions.quote: this is the day of the open door
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private financial guidance.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that in 2025 they will soar, calling it a 2025 turnaround and a year like they have never seen before, going through the open door in this window of opportunity and blessing.
mentions.quote: in 2025, we will soar. It's a 2025 turnaround
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the same year-word applied to 2025 that was applied to 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He says his practice is to seek God and everything else is added, and that God may tell him to plant a big garden this summer within the next couple of days.
mentions.quote: Brandon, I need you to plant a big garden this summer
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a hypothetical instruction.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord has been talking to him about the April eclipse, which happened a year ago, and asks his son to correct him if he misspeaks.
mentions.quote: the Lord has been talking to me about the eclipse in April
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: Answering viewers who say he got the six month window wrong, he clarifies he meant November, December, January, February, March and April, which is six months.
mentions.quote: people say, Well, you messed up on the six-month window
mentions.falsify_match: A defence by re-specification: the window is recounted after the fact rather than the miss conceded.

mentions.claim_text: On water storage he says he is a country boy who would find an old pond, however dirty and red the Oklahoma water looks, and drink from it through a life straw, because there are plenty of water patches around.
mentions.quote: you go up there and get it with those live straws and drink it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: practical advice.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer lifting heads vertically, saying God knows what is needed regardless, and that if a seed is sown he will take care of it.
mentions.quote: if I if I sew a seed, you'll take car
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private provision with a giving condition.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to go back and look at when the eclipse took place, that many dropped it though they had thought it serious, and that a lot of prophetic words went out about the American eclipse.
mentions.quote: I want you to go back and look at when the eclipse took place
mentions.falsify_match: Something of significance dated to the eclipse anniversary.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when people asked what he felt about the eclipse he was very blunt in every video that nothing was going to happen on 8 April, and that this was what the Lord said to him.
mentions.quote: there's nothing going to happen on April the 8th. That's what the Lord said
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing did happen on 8 April 2024, and the prior statement is in this corpus at dq4Jz74Kpfw@239.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the eclipse path through Oregon making a cross over Egypt, says the body of Christ was consumed with signs, that nothing happened, and tells them to watch Tuesday of the coming week.
mentions.quote: Nothing happened. Watch. That's all I can tell you
mentions.falsify_match: Something of note on 15 April 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He revisits the crashing of the economy and the oak trees, and the rioting after the dollar crashes when the government cannot pay social security cheques, welfare or food stamps.
mentions.quote: all the people uh rioting after the dollar crashes
mentions.falsify_match: A dollar collapse followed by suspended federal payments and rioting.

mentions.claim_text: He says he believes 2025 will be a dark year because of the dam he saw with Joe Biden and the things they were trying to hold back from being released until after the elections.
mentions.quote: 2025 is going to be a a a a dark year because of the dam
mentions.falsify_match: 2025 marked by crisis on the scale implied.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. Note this sits against the good-year-2025 claims he made in January.

mentions.claim_text: He says he warned of a major shaking to awaken and has seen a major thing trying to take place this week which everybody will see, and that it is the week of the eclipse one year on.
mentions.quote: I've seen a major thing trying to take place this this over this week
mentions.falsify_match: A major visible event in the week of 7 April 2025, which the tariff selloff would supply.

mentions.claim_text: He describes people unable to pay their mortgages, a new digital dollar coming about eventually, and says he saw food lines, empty grocery shelves and trade wars, asking whether they are at that place and praying they are not.
mentions.quote: I saw grocery shelves empty. I saw trade wars. I warned you trade wars
mentions.falsify_match: Mortgage defaults, empty shelves and a digital dollar arriving together.
mentions.falsify_miss: The trade war half arrived; the food and currency halves did not.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in 2023 he saw trade wars between China and America with Trump's face leading it, which made no sense then because Trump was not president and they were trying to imprison him.
mentions.quote: I see trade wars with China and America and there this is what's coming
mentions.falsify_match: The 2023 statement can be located in the corpus, which would make the April 2025 tariff war a genuine hit given Trump was not then president.

mentions.claim_text: He says people will be told there is a universal gospel and more ways to heaven than Jesus Christ, that all religions can get you there, and that he warned everybody about this in 2023.
mentions.quote: there's a universal gospel there's more ways to heaven than Jesus Christ
mentions.falsify_match: A prominent universalist turn in mainstream Christianity.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was not expecting what happened, tries to explain what the Holy Spirit shows him but cannot always put it into words, and that some things are so holy you do not want to say them.
mentions.quote: some things are just so holy you you don't wan
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it belongs with the other reasons some material never enters the public record.

mentions.claim_text: He reads Matthew 24 that nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom with famines and earthquakes in place after place, and pauses to underline that there will be famines and earthquakes.
mentions.quote: there will be famines and earthquakes in place after place
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as applied: famines and earthquakes occur in every period.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that everything changed in a twenty four hour period and says another major event is about to take place, noting an email telling him Cindy Jacobs had given a word about the same thing.
mentions.quote: another event is about to take place. Another major event is about to take place
mentions.falsify_match: A single-day transformative event.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, and no date is attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says the end is happening right in front of our faces, that God is pushing the dominoes and using Trump to get it done, and that Trump may not even know he is being used.
mentions.quote: using Trump to get it done. And he may not even know he's being used
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a reading of purpose behind events already underway.

mentions.claim_text: He says everything the Lord showed them before the inauguration is now in the news, points to Trump on Truth Social saying tariffs will be implemented on the second, and calls prayer over the economy.
mentions.quote: Everything the Lord showed us clear back before he was inaugurated, we're seeing it
mentions.falsify_match: Tariffs implemented on 2 April 2025, which was announced rather than foreseen.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are about to see the greatest harvest of souls this world has ever seen, and that the darkness can affect you if you stay horizontal but will not if you keep vertical.
mentions.quote: we're about to see the greatest harvest of souls this world has ever seen
mentions.condition_text: protection conditioned on staying vertical rather than horizontal
mentions.falsify_match: A revival exceeding every previous one in recorded scale.
